description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client-generated token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request, contain only ASCII characters, and not exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The ID of the lightweight database instance.

description.zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~2361076~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance. You can call [ListRegions](~~2361076~~) to view supported regions.

descriptions.zh: 轻量数据库实例默认不提供外网地址，如果您需要通过轻量容器服务或DMS公网访问数据库，您需要申请开启外网访问地址。
descriptions.en: By default, a lightweight database instance does not have a public connection. To access the database from a lightweight container service or DMS over the internet, you must allocate a public connection.
